title: 第5章 麻烦上门第6章 端茶倒水
lines: “今天早上，南月集团董事长的座驾在公司停车场突然发生爆炸，根据警方和南月集团透露的消息，这起爆炸事件只是意外，至于爆炸原因目前尚在调查中……”
在电视新闻中，画面的左上角除了一张被炸毁的劳斯莱斯照片，还搭配着一张女人的照片。看着照片中熟悉的脸庞，江来的眼神渐渐变得森然起来。
“总算找到了你了！我说过，无论你逃到天涯海角，我都不会放过你。”
次日。
清晨时分，在客厅沙发上睡了一宿的江来睁开眼，慢慢坐起身，然后从口袋里掏出一根烟点燃，猛吸了两口，顿时觉得神清气爽，整个人都精神了。
看了眼卧室紧闭的房门，他心里暗道：“这女人睡了这么久，难道还没醒？”想到这，他径直走向卧室，推门而入。
当门开的瞬间，一具美妙而白皙的胴体毫无遮掩的呈现在他眼前。房间内，叶芙渠一丝不挂，展现出婀娜多姿的曲线，一头乌黑的秀发湿漉漉的，洁白无瑕的肌肤上散发着淡淡的清香，旁边还放着刚刚脱下的浴袍。
此时，看到江来的突然出现，叶芙渠不由一呆，整个人愣在原地。几秒钟后，她终于反应过来，尖叫声脱口而出，急忙拿起浴袍遮挡住身上的隐私部位。
“你……你……”她脸色通红地看着江来，美眸中羞愤交加，这个家伙难道不知道敲门吗？居然直接闯进自己的卧室，害她春光外泄。
注意到对方的目光仍然直勾勾的盯着自己，丝毫没有回避的意思，叶芙渠只觉浑身燥热，白皙的肌肤上渐渐浮现出一抹诱人的绯红。
“你……你还看，快出去！”这一刻，她恨不得找条地缝钻进去，太羞人了。
“抱歉。”江来耸耸肩，神色淡淡的往外走去。到了门口，他突地停下脚步，回头道：“身材还不错，就是胸围小了点，以后多吃点木瓜补补。”
“混蛋！”叶芙渠快气死了，自己可是B+耶，在国内根本不算小了好吗？她又羞又愤，顺手抄起一个枕头砸了过去。可惜，江来已经先一步关上了房门。
趁着叶芙渠还在换衣服，江来来到厨房，从冰箱里找出鸡蛋和速食面，放在锅里一顿乱煮。本来还指望叶芙渠给自己这个客人准备吃的，不过，对方刚被自己撞见换衣服，以他对女人的了解，估计一时半会是出不来了。
吃完一锅糊汤面，江来满足的拍了拍鼓鼓的肚皮，然后掏出一根烟，在客厅里吞云吐雾。
烟快要抽完的时候，卧室的房门终于被打开，叶芙渠穿着一身白色居家服，袅袅娜娜的款步走出。看到沙发上的江来，她白皙滑嫩的脸颊上顿时升起两道灿烂的红霞，妩媚动人。
“叶小姐，既然你出来了，那我也该走了，再见。”江来掐灭烟头，起身便往门口走去。
“等等！”叶芙渠急忙追上他的脚步，道：“我们的生意还没谈完，你不能走。”
“生意？我不记得我有答应过你什么，昨晚是看你可怜，所以才好心送你回来，但你别得寸进尺。”说完，江来话锋一转，道：“对了！昨天晚上回来的时候，你家里来了客人，好像是个叫谭平的男人。”
“谭平？”叶芙渠面色一白，好像对这个人很是畏惧。她轻咬着薄唇，伸手想要去拉江来的胳膊，但是，感受到他不善的目光，她的动作不由一僵，只得放弃。
沉吟了一会，她缓缓道：“我不知道你是谁，也不想知道你的来历，但是，昨晚面对那么多人，你眼都不眨一下全杀了，说明你是个有真本事的人，所以，我想求你帮我杀一个人。只要他死了，我才能得到解脱，否则的话，就算我活着也是生不如死。”说完，她从口袋里将早已准备好的银行卡掏了出来，道：“这里面有六十万，是我这几年所有的积蓄，只要你替我杀了他，这些钱全都归你。”
江来连看都没看一眼，淡淡道：“叶小姐，我做事全凭个人喜好，而且……如果你真想出钱请我，那你至少得准备六千万美金，少一分都不行。”
“六……六千万……美金？”叶芙渠呆了呆，看着江来淡漠的神情，泪水不自觉的在眼眶中打转，“我知道你想让我知难而退，如果我有六千万美金，又何至于求你。”
看到她泫然欲泣的可怜模样，江来摇了摇头，没有接腔。以他的身份，六千万美金已经是友情价了。在国际市场上，即便有人出价，愿不愿意接受还要看他的心情。只是，他们毕竟是两个不同世界的人，在他看来理所当然的事情，对叶芙渠来说可能觉得匪夷所思。
“叶小姐，这些钱你还是留着另请高明吧。”话落，江来不再停留，举步走了出去。
看着关上的房门，叶芙渠娇躯微颤，整个人仿佛被抽干了力气，瘫坐在地上，忍不住掩面哭泣起来。对她而言，江来的拒绝无疑是判了她的死刑。
此刻，江来叼着香烟，乘坐电梯来到地下负一楼停车场，坐上面包车，他发动引擎，准备驾车离开小区。但这时，一辆奔驰轿车和两辆现代商务车从入口处迅速驶来，停在了电梯口。
随着车门打开，十多名虎背熊腰的男子鱼贯而下，手中握着长条状的物品，外层用报纸裹着。与此同时，在那辆奔驰轿车上，走下来两个人，一个是昨晚见过的谭平，脸颊上的红肿还未消退，反而更加严重，好像整张脸都变了形。
另一个四五十岁左右，大腹便便，满脸横肉，脑袋已经秃顶，手腕上戴着一串醒目的禅珠。下了车后，秃头男子走在前面，谭平和其他人尾随其后，快步进入了电梯中。
当电梯门缓缓关闭，坐在面包车内的江来微微皱起了眉头，那群人明显是去找叶芙渠的麻烦。虽然他不想多管闲事，但昨晚的事情是因他而起，万一谭平找不到他，把怒火发泄在叶芙渠身上，那该怎么办？
既然是他招惹的麻烦，总不能让一个女人替自己承担，那不是他的性格。想到这，他推开车门，径直往电梯口走去。
content_en:
"This morning, the car of the chairman of Nanyue Group suddenly exploded in the company's parking lot. According to information disclosed by the police and Nanyue Group, the explosion was just an accident. The cause of the explosion is still under investigation..."
In the TV news, in addition to a photo of a bombed Rolls-Royce in the upper left corner of the screen, there was also a photo of a woman. Looking at the familiar face in the photo, Jiang Lai's eyes gradually became serious.
"Finally I found you! I said, no matter how far you go, I will never let you go."
…
The next day.
In the early morning, Jiang Lai, who had slept on the sofa in the living room all night, opened his eyes, sat up slowly, took out a cigarette from his pocket, lit it, and took two puffs. He suddenly felt refreshed and energetic.
Glancing at the closed door of the bedroom, he thought to himself: "Has this woman not woken up after sleeping for so long?" Thinking of this, he walked straight to the bedroom and pushed the door open.
When the door opened, a beautiful and white body appeared in front of him without any concealment. In the room, Ye Fuqu was naked, showing off her graceful curves, with wet black hair, and a faint fragrance exuding from her flawless white skin. Next to her was a bathrobe she had just taken off.
At this time, seeing Jiang Lai's sudden appearance, Ye Fuqu couldn't help but froze in place. After a few seconds, she finally reacted, a scream escaped her lips, and she hurriedly picked up her bathrobe to cover her private parts.
"You...you..." She looked at Jiang Lai with a red face, shame and anger in her beautiful eyes. Doesn't this guy know how to knock on the door? He actually broke into his bedroom and caused her love affair to leak out.
Noticing that the other party's eyes were still staring directly at her, with no intention of avoiding him, Ye Fuqu felt hot all over, and a seductive blush gradually appeared on her fair skin.
"You...look, get out!" At this moment, she wanted to find a crack in the ground and crawl in. It was so embarrassing.
"Sorry." Jiang Lai shrugged and walked out with a calm expression. When he reached the door, he suddenly stopped and turned around and said: "The figure is not bad, but the bust is a bit small. I will eat more papaya to replenish my body."
"Asshole!" Ye Fuqu was almost furious. He was B+, so he was not considered young in China, okay? She was ashamed and angry, so she picked up a pillow and threw it at it. Unfortunately, Jiang Lai had already closed the door first.
While Ye Fuqu was still changing clothes, Jiang Lai came to the kitchen, found eggs and instant noodles from the refrigerator, and cooked them in a pot. I originally expected Ye Fuqu to prepare food for his guest, but he had just caught him changing his clothes. Based on his understanding of women, he probably wouldn't be able to come out for a while.
After finishing a pot of soup noodles, Jiang Lai patted his bulging belly with satisfaction, then took out a cigarette and puffed away in the living room.
When the cigarette was about to be finished, the bedroom door was finally opened, and Ye Fuqu, wearing a white housecoat, walked out with a graceful grace. Seeing Jiang Lai on the sofa, two bright red glows suddenly rose on her fair and smooth cheeks, making her charming and charming.
"Miss Ye, since you're out, it's time for me to leave. Goodbye." Jiang Lai put out his cigarette butt, got up and walked towards the door.
"Wait!" Ye Fuqu hurriedly caught up with him and said, "We haven't finished talking about the business, you can't leave."
"Business? I don't remember what I promised you. I felt sorry for you last night, so I kindly sent you back, but don't push yourself too far." After saying that, Jiang Lai changed the subject and said, "By the way! When I came back last night, there was a guest at your house, and it seemed that he was a man named Tan Ping."
"Tan Ping?" Ye Fuqu's face turned pale, as if he was very afraid of this man. She bit her thin lips lightly and reached out to pull Jiang Lai's arm. However, feeling his unkind gaze, her movements froze and she had to give up.
After pondering for a while, she slowly said: "I don't know who you are, and I don't want to know your origins. However, in the face of so many people last night, you killed them all without blinking, which shows that you are a person with real abilities. Therefore, I want to ask you to help me kill one person. As long as he dies, I will I can get relief, otherwise, even if I live, my life will be worse than death." After that, she took out the bank card she had prepared and said: "There are 600,000 yuan in it, which is all my savings in the past few years. As long as you kill him for me, all the money will be yours."
Jiang Lai didn't even look at it and said calmly: "Miss Ye, I do everything based on personal preference, and... if you really want to pay me, then you have to prepare at least 60 million US dollars, no less."
"Sixty...sixty million...US dollars?" Ye Fuqu was stunned, looking at Jiang Lai's indifferent expression, tears welling up in his eyes unconsciously, "I know you want me to quit in spite of the difficulties. If I have 60 million US dollars, why would I beg you?"
Seeing her pitiful look on the verge of tears, Jiang Lai shook his head and said nothing. Given his status, 60 million US dollars is already a friendly price. In the international market, even if someone makes an offer, whether he is willing to accept it or not depends on his mood. However, after all, they are people from two different worlds, and what seems to him to be a matter of course may be strange to Ye Fuqu.
"Miss Ye, you'd better keep the money and hire someone else." After saying that, Jiang Lai walked out without stopping.
Looking at the closed door, Ye Fuqu's delicate body trembled slightly, and her whole body seemed to have been drained of strength. She collapsed on the ground and couldn't help covering her face and crying. For her, Jiang Lai's refusal was undoubtedly her death sentence.
At this moment, Jiang Lai, holding a cigarette in his mouth, took the elevator to the parking lot on the first floor underground, got into the van, started the engine, and prepared to drive out of the community. But at this time, a Mercedes-Benz sedan and two modern commercial vehicles drove quickly from the entrance and stopped at the elevator entrance.
As the car door opened, more than a dozen hunky-backed men filed out, holding long items in their hands wrapped in newspapers. At the same time, two people got out of the Mercedes-Benz sedan. One was Tan Ping, whom he had met last night. The redness and swelling on his cheeks had not subsided, but became more serious, as if his entire face had been deformed.
The other one is about forty or fifty years old, with a big belly, a fleshy face, a bald head, and a string of eye-catching Zen beads on his wrist. After getting off the car, the bald man walked in front, followed by Tan Ping and others, and quickly entered the elevator.
When the elevator door slowly closed, Jiang Lai, who was sitting in the van, frowned slightly. The group of people were obviously looking for trouble with Ye Fuqu. Although he didn't want to meddle in other people's business, what happened last night was because of him. What if Tan Ping couldn't find him and vented his anger on Ye Fuqu?
Since it was him who caused the trouble, he couldn't let a woman bear it for him. That was not his character. Thinking of this, he opened the car door and walked straight to the elevator.
